== Missing data ==
* The previous lead treated Starting Effects as a Players Committee-only type (2003–2008). Decipher printed [[Fear Is My Ally]] and [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear]] in Reflections III (31 October 2001). Added 16 October 2026.
